notes: Stories refined for clearer separation of concerns (validation vs routing vs integration vs tests). No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Clarified strict alignment to Anthropic tool_use contract and standardized 422 error structure with field-level detail
Explicit separation of allowlist enforcement, schema binding, payload normalization, and structured debug logging
Clarified token-bound truncation, role filtering, and mandatory de-identification aligned to consent_service before injection
Clarified Anthropic tool_use parsing, router invocation, and normalized response mapping in FastAPI loop
Expanded coverage to include malformed tool_use blocks, partial inputs, and edge-case validation failures

stories.title: Tool Schema and Validation Contract
stories.description: Define Pydantic schemas for all allowlisted tools with strict input models, required/optional fields, defaults, and standardized 422 validation errors with field-level detail. Schemas must align exactly with Anthropic tool_use structure (name + input payload).

stories.title: Allowlist-Based Tool Routing Logic
stories.description: Implement routing engine enforcing explicit allowlist, binding tools to schemas, validating inputs, normalizing payloads, rejecting unknown tools, and emitting structured debug logs (tool name, validation outcome, rejection reason).

stories.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
stories.description: Implement controlled chat history injection with token-bound truncation, role filtering, and mandatory de-identification aligned with consent_service before tool execution.

stories.title: Tool Router API Integration with Main Loop
stories.description: Integrate router into FastAPI main loop: parse Anthropic tool_use blocks, invoke routing, handle validation vs execution errors, and normalize outputs into Anthropic-compatible response blocks.

stories.title: Tool Routing and Validation Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation success/failure, dispatch correctness, chat history injection, malformed tool_use blocks, unknown tools, partial inputs, and edge cases.
